_readme: Your hand-picked opportunities. Add objects to the items list below (or paste what the site's Export JSON button gives you). Required: title, type, url. Everything else is optional; leave a date as null if unknown. Set expected to true for programmes whose dates are not announced yet. Items here are always marked verified and are never removed for missing dates, only when their deadline (or end date) has passed.

items.title: Science Academies Summer Research Fellowship 2027 (IASc-INSA-NASI)
items.organiser: Indian Academy of Sciences, INSA & NASI
items.stipend_or_prize: Stipend for the 8-week fellowship (amount on site)
items.eligibility: UG/PG science & engineering students at Indian institutions; check year and marks criteria

items.title: RIKEN Center for Brain Science Summer Program 2027
items.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in neuroscience research

items.title: Weizmann Kupcinet-Getz International Summer Program 2027
items.eligibility: Students currently enrolled in an undergraduate science degree (life sciences, CS, maths, physics, chemistry)

items.title: NUS Amgen Scholars Asia 2027
items.organiser: National University of Singapore / Amgen Foundation
items.stipend_or_prize: Funded programme (travel, housing, stipend: see site)
items.eligibility: Undergraduates in science/engineering; needs TOEFL 72 or IELTS 5.5

items.title: ETH Zurich Student Summer Research Fellowship 2027 (Computer Science)
items.organiser: ETH Zurich, Department of Computer Science
items.eligibility: Undergrad/master's students with a strong CS background; comp-bio projects possible

items.title: HZDR Summer Student Program 2027
items.stipend_or_prize: Financial support for summer students (see site)
items.eligibility: Undergraduate students in natural sciences or engineering

items.title: IIT Hyderabad SURE 2027 (Summer Undergraduate Research Exposure)
items.eligibility: Non-IITH undergraduates in the top 20% of their class; full-time on campus
items.notes: Expected Feb 2027, deadline not announced yet

items.title: IIT Madras Summer Fellowship Programme 2027
items.eligibility: Non-IIT UG engineering students (historically 3rd year); check if 2nd-years qualify
items.notes: Expected Feb 2027. If sfp.iitm.ac.in doesn't load, check ssp.iitm.ac.in

items.title: IIT Gandhinagar SRIP 2027 (Summer Research Internship Programme)
items.eligibility: Undergraduate students; check eligibility when the call opens
items.notes: Expected Feb to Mar 2027, deadline not announced yet
